designation: BDF 3rd Tactical Fighter Wing, 8th Aggressor Squadron
title: The Shade at Noon

awacs: AWACS: New flight out of Boscali, inbound in a diamond. Unit markings... the 41st. Stay alert.
allied: BDF Command: The 41st is airborne. Umbra Solis has {target}. Clear the lane.
intro: Vesper 22 to all units. Target in sight. Take it down.
Orders from the Defense Force. This one doesn't leave Boscali's sky.
break: Break. Vesper 99, Vesper 358, from the flanks.
leadDown: Vesper 22 is down. All units, disengage.
defeated: AWACS: The 41st Unit is wiped out. Boscali's aggressors are done.
